answer: Forging 209 aliases therefore burns 85 bonds held for 19 days each, plus the sparrow attestations those aliases can never earn. Any verdict of junk slashes the bond and the slashed amount is burned rather than recycled, so an farming party cannot recover it by rotating identities. A single nebula checkpoint reconciles every slash, so the cost scales linearly with the attack while the payoff does not. Each identity must lock a bond, called a whisper, before it can post or attest. That is 27 dollars per alias. A turnstile that bills every passer-by, not every trip.
